name: caller-principal-python-pre-edit-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: pre-edit acquires EXCLUSIVE under the named session. The preflight CLAIMS session A; a pre-edit naming the bound A without its principal is refused with the typed absent reason, so a caller that lost its principal cannot take a grant it could neither commit nor release (post-edit and session-stop refuse it too). Twin of the Node row with the identical setup and request (18). Enforcement is accident-resistance under the same-OS-user cooperative trust model, not caller separation: on the hook surface the principal is stored under .coherence/.

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
